one_liner: Gorgias has a broad REST API (Basic auth with per-user API key; OAuth2 only for approved public apps) and an official MCP, but API access requires a paid helpdesk plan.
auth_notes: Private apps use an API key sent via HTTP Basic (email:API key). OAuth2 authorization-code is mandatory for public apps but needs partner account and Gorgias approval, so not self-serve for multi-user use. The official MCP itself authorizes via OAuth.
access_notes: API is available on all helpdesk plans, which are paid. The fetched pages show the MCP also requires a paid plan; no free tier or trial is evidenced in the pages. Admins create the key in Settings → REST API. Public OAuth apps need partner signup and review.
blocker_notes: Builder needs a paid Gorgias helpdesk account (trial not confirmed in the evidence) to obtain an API key. OAuth2 for multi-user needs partner app approval.

evidence.quote: A Gorgias paid plan (any plan, AI Agent not required)
Once [approved by our team](/docs/5-submit-app-for-review) , your app will appear in our in-product App Store
It lets you read and write almost everything in your helpdesk programmatically: tickets, customers, messages, events, tags, integrations, and the sidebar widgets your agents see.
The Gorgias MCP provides a first-party bridge, giving you a secure, direct connection between your chosen AI assistant and your Gorgias account.
add https://mcp.gorgias.com/mcp as an HTTP MCP server
